Veidekke ASA (org.nr 917 103 801) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1936-02-06, registered 1995-02-19. Business address: Standardveien 28B, 0581 OSLO. Main industry (NACE): 41.000 Oppføring av bygninger. Registered employees: 52 (as of 2026-08-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 124,000,000; operating result NOK -195,000,000; net result NOK 1,640,000,000; total assets NOK 6,808,000,000; equity NOK 1,355,000,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 43,143,000,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Jimmy Fredrik Bengtsson; board chair Egil Haugsdal; 9 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXHF4O96 (ACTIVE).
